details: Bitcoin's price has experienced a significant decline, falling below the $60,000 mark. This downturn is largely attributed to a broader sell-off in technology stocks, a hawkish stance from the Federal Reserve which signals higher interest rates, and continuous outflows from Bitcoin Spot Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs). BlackRock's IBIT, for instance, saw $182 million in losses contributing to overall Bitcoin ETF outflows of $114 million.
title: Bitcoin Price Dips Below $60K Amid Macro Headwinds & ETF Outflows

details: The Ethereum Foundation has announced a significant restructuring, cutting approximately 20% of its staff, totaling 54 positions, and reducing its annual budget by 40%. This decision comes as the price of ETH has fallen 44% year-to-date and network fees have decreased, despite experiencing record usage.
title: Ethereum Foundation Reduces Workforce by 20%

details: Ripple has expanded its stablecoin offerings by launching its US dollar-pegged stablecoin, RLUSD, in Japan. This move follows the receipt of necessary regulatory approvals, marking a strategic entry into the Japanese market for Ripple's stablecoin ecosystem.
title: Ripple Launches RLUSD Stablecoin in Japan Following Regulatory Nod

details: Bitcoin miners are currently experiencing a significant margin squeeze as their revenue has dropped below their production costs. This trend indicates increasing financial pressure on mining operations, potentially impacting their profitability and sustainability in the evolving crypto market.
title: Bitcoin Miners Face Intensifying Margin Squeeze
